continue.why_recommended: The stress-related evidence shows a practice that already lowers load or supports recovery, so that resource should be protected.
continue.completion_signal: After two stress events, observe that recovery time did not continue to lengthen.

start.why_recommended: The matched evidence supports addressing load early with a low-effort, reversible action.
start.completion_signal: Complete the action once and record whether subjective load changed afterward.

stop.why_recommended: The current pattern may let stimulation or rumination occupy recovery space; removing one amplifier is more direct than adding another task.
stop.completion_signal: End one stress-amplifying input or loop and record whether recovery began sooner.

observe.why_recommended: Recovery improves when triggers, peaks, and decline are separated; the evidence supports establishing a personal baseline first.
observe.completion_signal: Record the trigger, peak, and recovery duration for three stress events.

rules.title: Start 10-minute disengagement recovery
rules.body: Every time you clearly feel that the load is being stretched, physically disengage for 10 minutes first, and do not continue to carry it while exerting pressure.

rules.title: Schedule a protected recovery window
rules.body: If your system is in a state of high alert for a long time, please treat the recovery period as a schedule that cannot be diverted at will, rather than waiting to make up for it after everything is over.

rules.title: Stop brushing and restore at the same time
rules.body: Don't scroll through messages and recover at the same time when you're under high load; for you, that's not relaxing, but a different kind of stimulation that continues to hold up the system.

rules.title: Compare expected cost to actual cost
rules.body: Record for two consecutive weeks: What is the bad outcome you are worried about and what is the cost of it actually happening, to help the system return to the facts from the rehearsal.

rules.title: After the conflict, leave the high-stimulation area first
rules.body: When a conflict has just ended, do not immediately switch to a new highly interactive or stimulating context; let the system slow down first, and then decide whether to continue communication.

rules.title: Only perform minimal restart actions after recovery
rules.body: After recovery, don't ask yourself to return to full efficiency immediately. Only do a minimal restart action, such as opening a file, listing three items, or completing the first step.
